Market today: Tech is still the driver, but inflation whispers are a concern. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, means any dip hits hard.

Your holdings: SOXL (-33.44%) and SPAL (-17.73%) are flagged for attention. They're leveraged ETFs and decay is a killer, especially when losing.

Watch: Keep an eye on the AI narrative and how it impacts chip demand, especially with funds rotating out of the trade.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged losers and watch for any signs of broader market weakness.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting. Leveraged ETFs decay, and the -33.44% loss amplifies margin risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, consider trimming or exiting due to leverage and decay. The -17.73% loss is a concern.
